tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Disables SIMD for non-12 LJ repulsion and logs the plain-C fallback.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: TP1.3 cut-off and PME runs both report repulsion power 9 and plain-C reference kernels.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Selects full pair matrix for non-12 repulsion.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: PCFF 9-6 cut-off-only path uses explicit pair parameters rather than optimized combination-rule kernels.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Initializes NBNxM kernel setup and pairlist pruning.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: This is the cut-off-only short-range setup entrypoint used by TP1.3.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Maps Coulomb Cut-off to the ReactionField kernel family.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: Cut-off-only does not enter PME reciprocal-space code; it enters the RF-style direct kernel path.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Selects cut-off LJ kernel variant with full combination matrix.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: The problematic path is cut-off LJ with repulsion power 9 and no LJ-PME.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Dispatches CPU plain-C or SIMD kernels to actual pairlists.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: TP1.3 logs show plain-C-4x4 dispatch for both PME and cut-off runs.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Applies exclusions, cut-off masking, LJ 9-6 force/energy, RF-style Coulomb, and shift bookkeeping.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: This is the exact plain-C reference loop exercised by the cut-off-only fixture family.

tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.physical_role: Chooses pairlist lifetime and inner/outer list radii under Verlet.
tp1_3_cutoff_only_path.why_suspected: Neighbor-list cadence was a candidate family, but TP1.3 logs keep the update period at 10 for both PME and cut-off.
